summary: Reports that the Lincoln Laboratory 360/67 passed testing of its network software, including the NCP, ICP, Telnet as user and server, login, CMS access, and operator communication. Everything behaved according to specs. It updates RFC 193 and was replaced by RFC 214.

plainLanguage.summary: A short test report that says the computer passed all the checks, even when many people used it.

subtitle: Lincoln Labs certified its network computer

tldr.problem: The ARPANET needed to verify that new hosts were working correctly before they joined the network.
tldr.mechanism: Engineers tested the Lincoln Laboratory 360/67 computer by running all its network software: NCP, ICP, Telnet, login, CMS access, and operator communication against specifications.
tldr.outcome: The 360/67 passed all tests and was certified ready for the network, even under heavy load.

today: RFC 198 is historic and has been superseded by RFC 214. The 360/67 is no longer in operation, but the testing procedures described established patterns for certifying ARPANET nodes.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: RFC 198 reports the results of testing the Lincoln Laboratory 360/67 computer's network software. The computer was tested against the current specifications to verify it was ready to operate as a node on the ARPANET.
sections.plainLanguage: This is a report card for a computer's internet parts. All the tests passed.

sections.title: Test Coverage
sections.content:
The test covered several critical network systems: the Network Control Protocol (NCP), the Initial Connection Protocol (ICP), Telnet as both user and server, the login procedure, access to CMS (an operating system), and operator and console communication. All systems performed according to their specifications.

Testing included both light and moderate to heavy load conditions. Multiple message responses, such as user listings, remained smooth under heavy load.
sections.plainLanguage: Engineers tried every button and checked that everything worked right, even when the computer was very busy.

sections.title: Result
sections.content: The Lincoln Laboratory 360/67 passed all tests and was certified as ready for network operation. RFC 198 updates RFC 193 with this information.
sections.plainLanguage: The computer got a gold star and was ready to join the network.
